text: You have no right to nag me about cheating on my diet when you ate a whole pizza by yourself last night.

text: So because you said the dress code is too strict, you basically want everyone walking around naked and screwing in the hallways.

text: I met two guys from that gym and both were dumb meatheads, so everyone who trains there is a brainless jock.
